description: This file contains implementation of arithmetic and logical operations for rational numbers, including shift, bitwise, remainder, and modulus functions, specifically for the 'ratpak' library.

methods.name: lshrat
methods.description: Performs left shift operation on a rational number by a specified radix and precision.

methods.name: rshrat
methods.description: Performs right shift operation on a rational number by a specified radix and precision.

methods.name: andrat
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: orrat
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: xorrat
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: boolrat
methods.description: Performs logical bitwise operation (AND, OR, XOR) on rational numbers.

methods.name: boolnum
methods.description: Performs logical bitwise operation (AND, OR, XOR) on unsigned numbers.

methods.name: remrat
methods.description: Calculates the remainder of division of two rational numbers, with sign matching the dividend.

methods.name: modrat
methods.description: Calculates the modulus of division of two rational numbers, with sign matching the divisor, handling negative values differently than remrat.
